Markets.title: RBI to close FCNR(B) swaps a month earlier due to gush
Markets.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has moved the FCNR(B) deposit swap deadline to August 31 due to stronger-than-expected foreign currency inflows. Meanwhile, swap schemes for External Commercial Borrowings and Overseas Foreign Currency Borrowings will proceed as planned.

Markets.title: Wall St Week Ahead: With US Fed silent on next move, investors look to earnings to keep stocks afloat
Markets.summary: Investors are focusing on corporate earnings to offset economic risks and interest rate concerns as the Federal Reserve remains silent on its next policy move. Strong financial results and positive company guidance are currently boosting market confidence and outweighing broader macroeconomic worries.

Markets.title: US stock: S&P 500 ends lower as investors weigh data, Middle East tensions
Markets.summary: The S&P 500 fell from its peak as weaker retail sales and rising Middle East tensions caused investor caution. Declines in Applied Materials dragged down AI stocks, while rising oil prices lifted the energy index and Reddit surged on index inclusion news.

Markets.title: Nvidia’s $500 billion plan envelops Wall Street in its AI frenzy
Markets.summary: Nvidia has launched a financing initiative with major financial institutions to provide debt solutions for AI startups. This strategy aims to help these companies acquire artificial intelligence chips and address the high demand for computing power.

Markets.title: How a $900 million bet on SpaceX turned 100x into $94 billion for Alphabet
Markets.summary: Alphabet's initial $900 million investment in SpaceX has grown by 100x to become worth approximately $94 billion. This massive return makes Alphabet the largest institutional shareholder in the rocket company.

Markets.title: Patanjali Foods Q1 Results: Gross profit rises 35% YoY to Rs 1,521 crore
Markets.summary: Patanjali Foods reported a 29.33% increase in revenue to ₹11,337 crore and a 35.22% rise in gross profit to ₹1,521 crore for the first quarter of FY27. Driven by record revenues and strong execution, the company also declared two interim dividends.

Geo-Political.title: Mangione admits killing healthcare CEO and pleads guilty to federal charges
Geo-Political.summary: Twenty-eight-year-old Mangione admitted to shooting and killing a healthcare CEO in Manhattan. He subsequently pleaded guilty in federal court to charges of stalking resulting in death.

Geo-Political.title: Afghan women tell the BBC their lives are unrecognisable after five years of Taliban rule
Geo-Political.summary: Five years after the Taliban took control of Afghanistan, women report that their lives are unrecognizable due to severe restrictions. They face public floggings, job losses, and dangerous barriers to healthcare.

Geo-Political.title: US aircraft carrier on way to relieve USS Lincoln after issues reported on board
Geo-Political.summary: A US aircraft carrier is deploying to relieve the USS Lincoln following reports of food shortages and broken plumbing on board. Some sailors on the Lincoln have reportedly considered jumping overboard due to these conditions.

Geo-Political.title: Instagram accounts fuelling Ceuta crisis with paid advice for help to cross
Geo-Political.summary: The BBC's Top Comment podcast uncovered a network of Instagram accounts that romanticize the swim around the Morocco-Ceuta border fence. These profiles provide paid advice to individuals seeking help to cross the border.

Geo-Political.title: Activists try to deliver aid to Palestinians in homes besieged by Israeli settlers
Geo-Political.summary: Activists are attempting to deliver humanitarian aid to two Palestinian families trapped in their West Bank homes by Israeli settlers. These families have been besieged inside their residences for several days.

Geo-Political.title: 'Unprecedented' rain in Japan kills eight people
Geo-Political.summary: Unprecedented rain in Japan has killed eight people and left over 20,000 households without power. The severe storm also stranded 7,000 people at Tokyo's Narita airport.

AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic generation from traditional SEO to AI optimization.

Data & Insights.title: India's WPI inflation cools marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel prices ease
Data & Insights.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index inflation eased slightly to 9.78% in July due to a moderation in fuel and power inflation to 20.05%. However, inflation for primary articles and manufactured products accelerated during the same period.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India’s merchandise trade deficit widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. However, merchandise exports grew 17% to $173.78 billion during the April-July period compared to the previous year.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation slowed to 3.4% year-on-year in July, matching analyst expectations. This decline, driven by volatile oil prices, may give the Federal Reserve more flexibility regarding interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, staying above the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by higher food and fuel prices, compounded by rising global oil costs.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings has maintained India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for the 20th consecutive year, supported by a strong economic growth outlook of 6.4%. However, the agency also highlighted potential fiscal risks stemming from youth protests over employment issues.

India.title: NEET MDS Counselling 2026 Dates Out: Round 1 Registration From August 18
India.summary: The dates for the 2026 NEET MDS counselling have been officially released. Round 1 registration will start on August 18, leading into the choice filling, seat allotment, and admission procedures.

India.title: IPS Officer Nupur Prasad, Who Led Sushant Singh Rajput Probe, Awarded President's Medal
India.summary: IPS officer Nupur Prasad has been selected to receive the President's Medal for Distinguished Service. She previously led the CBI investigation into the death of actor Sushant Singh Rajput.

India.title: "Dimaagi Naxals Need To Be Identified, Isolated": PM Warns In I-Day Speech
India.summary: During his Independence Day speech, Prime Minister Modi warned that individuals with "urban Naxal" mentalities must be identified and isolated. He stated that these ideological extremists pose a threat to the nation and need to be separated from society.

India.title: Brought 650 New Universities, Doubled Medical Seats, Since 2014: Modi
India.summary: During his Independence Day address, Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that India has added 650 new universities since 2014. He also highlighted that the country has more than doubled its medical seats during the same period.

India.title: Mallikarjun Kharge, Rahul Gandhi Skip Independence Day Event For 2nd Straight Year
India.summary: Congress leaders Mallikarjun Kharge and Rahul Gandhi skipped the official Independence Day celebrations at Red Fort for the second consecutive year. Kharge, who serves as the Leader of the Opposition in the Rajya Sabha, instead hoisted the national flag at the Congress headquarters in New Delhi.

India.title: 80th Independence Day Live Updates: "Take Credit, But...": PM Modi's Appeal To Political Parties On Women Quota
India.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi led India's 80th Independence Day celebrations at the Red Fort in Delhi. During the event, he urged political parties to take credit for the women's reservation quota.

General.title: Jason Arday, ex-Cambridge professor at centre of plagiarism row, found dead
General.summary: Jason Arday, a former Cambridge professor who was recently at the center of a plagiarism controversy, was found dead in London on Friday. His family expressed profound shock at the loss of the academic, father, and partner.

General.title: Fires prompt national alert as 19 homes destroyed
General.summary: Nineteen homes were destroyed by 37 active fires burning across England and Wales. The situation has prompted the prime minister to issue a national alert.

General.title: Temporary ban on disposable BBQs as military deployed to help battle wildfires
General.summary: The government has temporarily banned disposable barbecues due to the severe risk of wildfires during current drought and heatwave conditions. Meanwhile, the military has been deployed to help emergency services battle the ongoing blazes.
